section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single cross-national validation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Denmark, Portugal, and Sweden with N = 1012 adolescents and young adults (ages 12–19). Confirmatory factor analyses supported a one-factor structure and invariance across sex and country; BAS-2 correlated positively with self-esteem, psychological well-being, and intuitive eating, and showed negative correlations with BMI for both boys and girls in Portugal but not in Denmark and Sweden. The abstract does not report survey method, racial composition, mean age, mean BMI, or whether BMI was self-reported or measured.
